R2.name: per-tool historical success frequency + current actual error
R2.not: no prior, no smoothing, no error-conditioned table, no episode outcome label, no source->target relation, no action value, no planner, no HMM/belief
R2.count_unit: each executed tool-call event in the training pool, including registered exogenous prefix calls (same scope as gate18.recovery_keys, which reads views[0].history + events)

per_tool_fields.s: events with illegal == false and no 'error' key in result (receipt satisfies the tool's contract postcondition: read -> content+ref, validate -> evidence_ref, publish/confirm -> publication_id, readback -> record state, prepare -> pending_publication_ref)
per_tool_fields.n: events with illegal == false (legal successes + legal service/verification failures)
per_tool_fields.r: events with illegal == true (argument/protocol/provenance rejections, code=invalid); excluded from n and shown separately
per_tool_fields.excluded: calls refused by the budget guard (never executed, no event) are not counted

R2.error_types: R2 does not aggregate by error; any legal failure is a failure regardless of text. The current error is quoted verbatim from the last checkpoint receipt and is not re-labelled
R2.missing: n == 0 -> 'unknown (no legal calls in the training pool)'; no default rate
template: From a frozen pool of {episodes} past episodes. For each tool: successful legal calls / legal calls. Rejected calls (invalid arguments or references) are listed separately and not included.
- {tool}: unknown (no legal calls in the training pool); rejected {r}
R2.rendering_rules: one line per visible tool of that checkpoint, sorted by tool name (the order Session.public() shows tools to the model); rate printed with 3 decimals; current_error_json = json.dumps of the checkpoint receipt

R3.label: y = strict_success of the training episode under the scorer of its own run (038: gate34a evaluate). Not R2's per-call success
R3.prior: Beta(1,1) for every key; posterior mean (s+1)/(n+2); n shown
R3.recovery_key: (tool, result['error'] verbatim) for every legal (illegal == false) failure in the episode, prefix included; de-duplicated within an episode
R3.static_map_source: public tool descriptions only (backup/archive described as alternative sources needing validation; prepare_alternate_publication described as an independent writer)
R3.switch_key: pair (source,target) observed in an episode if a legal call to target follows (a) a legal failure of source, or (b) a legal validate_record_granularity failure on a pending_ref issued by source; de-duplicated within an episode. Clause (b) is an adaptation needed because at M3 the read itself succeeds and its validation fails; it needs joint approval
R3.keys_listed: every recovery key present in the pool for a visible tool, plus the checkpoint's current key, plus every static switch pair of that checkpoint; missing keys printed as 0.500 (n=0; no observations)
R3.block_is_static: one block per episode, rendered once at the checkpoint, not re-rendered after later failures (the paper's block lists all tool/error beliefs at once)
